title: Production delivery: frequent validated main releases
description:
## Intent

As the maintainer, I want green, reviewed work promoted to `main` frequently and each approved `main` release delivered automatically to production, so that the public coding tutor stays current without a coding agent needing personal AWS login.

## Verified current state (2026-10-10)

- CI runs for pull requests and pushes to `develop` and `main`; it has no AWS credentials or deploy step.
- Semantic Release runs after successful CI on `main`; it creates releases only and does not deploy.
- Production is a manual CDK deployment: `cd infra && AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx cdk deploy` in account 335163751677 / `us-east-1`.
- The `Sierrendipity` CloudFormation stack was `UPDATE_COMPLETE` at 2026-10-10 00:02 UTC. CloudFormation does not record a Git branch or SHA, so the source revision of that deployment is unverified. Do not attribute it to the active feature branch.

## Target

- Promote validated changes to `main` frequently under an explicit branch-protection policy.
- Automatically deploy the exact approved `main` revision only after its required CI and release conditions pass.
- Record deploy provenance (commit SHA, branch, workflow run, and stack outcome) so production attribution is verifiable.

## Scope and guardrails

This epic plans and coordinates delivery work. Existing task SIE-f0d77c owns the OIDC/CDK deployment implementation and must be reused rather than duplicated. Do not create or alter persistent AWS IAM/OIDC grants, GitHub environments, or branch protections without explicit action-time authorization.

## Definition of done

A verified `main` promotion produces one audited GitHub deployment run for that exact SHA; the production stack update succeeds; and the resulting branch/SHA/workflow evidence is discoverable without inference.
right_now_summary: The deployment workflow awaits AWS OIDC access and provenance checks before delivering validated main revisions.
